categories.main_business_segments: Changzhou Tiansheng New Materials Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in polymer new materials, focusing on soft foam materials, structural foam materials, functional application products, and traffic supporting products such as sound barriers. The company provides integrated solutions from raw material production to precision processing, serving industries including engineering machinery, home appliances, automotive, rail transit, medical devices, and new energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced polymer foaming technologies including physical and cross-linking foaming for plastics and rubber materials. It utilizes precision coating, optical technology, printing, and EMI shielding technologies for functional tapes and films. Production methods include flexible manufacturing based on sales orders, precision die-cutting in cleanroom environments, and integrated R&D with patented formulations and processes for high-performance, environmentally friendly products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in sectors such as engineering machinery, automotive, home appliances, rail transit, medical devices, 3C electronics, and new energy storage. The company has established long-term relationships with well-known domestic and international brands, supplying polymer foam materials, functional components, and precision tapes. Major markets include domestic sales (84.5%) and export markets (15.5%), with a focus on high-end applications and customized solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries in Changzhou and other Chinese cities. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in the USA and Hong Kong, including Composites USA LLC and Polyumac USA LLC, supporting its international market expansion and technology acquisition.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tiansheng New Materials operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the polymer materials supply chain. It produces raw polymer foam materials and further processes them into functional components and finished products, offering integrated solutions to end customers. The company also engages in R&D and technical services, positioning itself beyond a simple material supplier to a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and new product development as core strategies, focusing on green, low-carbon materials and high-precision film preparation. R&D priorities include developing high-end rubber foam products, solvent-free environmentally friendly tapes, high shock-absorption composites, and advanced sound barrier materials. It invests in expanding its R&D team, collaborating with universities and research institutes, and upgrading production technologies to enhance product performance and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of polymer foam materials, functional application products, and traffic-related products. The company uses a direct sales model for foam and functional products and a bidding process for sound barrier products. Other income includes government subsidies and investment returns, but the main revenue stream is product sales to industrial customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tiansheng New Materials is a nationally recognized leader in polymer foam materials in China, holding a leading market position in soft foam and functional application products. It competes with other polymer material manufacturers but differentiates itself through integrated solutions, advanced technology, and certifications such as ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949, DNV, and DIN5510. The company aims to strengthen its competitive edge by focusing on high-end product development and expanding into emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 531 million, a 7.49% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 58.65 million, showing a significant reduction in loss compared to prior years. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 854 million, down 26.39% year-over-year. The company has experienced continuous losses over recent years but is narrowing the deficit and investing in strategic growth areas. Cash flow from operations was negative, reflecting liquidity challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, integrated polymer material solutions combining raw material production, advanced processing, and customized product design. It emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly, and high-performance products with proprietary technologies and patents. Its value proposition includes providing one-stop solutions, rapid response to customer needs, and compliance with stringent international quality and environmental standards, enabling it to replace foreign brands in key applications and maintain strong customer loyalty.
